1.
Heard Sri Siddharth Singh, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Anil Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for revisionist and learned A.G.A. for State.

2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 21.09.1989 passed by Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offences), Deoria in Case No. 1524 of 1989 convicting and sentencing the revisionist under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as ?Act, 1954?).

Thereagainst accused-revisionist preferred appeal which has been dismissed by 2nd Additional Sessions Judge,
Deoria vide judgment and order dated 01.10.1993.
This revision has been filed challenging both the aforesaid orders.

3. The only argument challenging the conviction of revisionist is that there is non compliance of Section 13(2) of Act, 1954, but Courts below have recorded finding of fact referring to evidence on Ravindra Prasad vs State on 17 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94420974/
1 record that notice under Section 13(2) was sent and registry receipt has been proved.

sentences.text: When questioned, learned counsel for revisionist neither could dispute this fact nor could show that the aforesaid finding recorded by Courts below is perverse or contrary to record.
I, therefore, find no occasion to interfere with impugned judgments on this score.

4. No other point has been argued.
5.
6. The revisionist Ravindra Prasad is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Deoria shall cause him to be arrested and lodged in jail to serve out sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be reported within two months.
7. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.

7. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.
